DisplayName.Value: Network Studio — Road Furniture & Sign Placement

ShortDescription.Value: Move speed signs, street lamps, signals, and props off asphalt to road verges with live preview.

Publish.LongDescription:
⚠️ **BETA / PUBLIC TEST BUILD (v0.1.0)**
*Network Studio is an experimental road customization and prop manipulation tool.*
---
**Clean up your road networks.** Network Studio allows you to customize the position, lateral offset, and placement of road furniture, overhead gantries, street lamps, and traffic signals across any road segment in your city.
### Key Features - **Road Furniture Detection**: Identifies all attached subobjects and props along any selected road or highway segment. - **Verge Relocation**: Move signs and props off the asphalt surface to the left or right verge with a single click. - **Fine-Grained Lateral Offsets**: Customize prop lateral placement with instant live in-world rendering updates. - **Native CS2 UI Integration**: Top-left launcher button and responsive inspector panel. - **100% Safe**: Non-destructive prop offset management.
Publish.ChangeLog: ### 0.1.0 BETA — Initial Public Test Release - Subobject scanning for road edges. - Verge relocation and lateral offset controls. - Dedicated UI inspector and in-world transform synchronization.
